description: This file defines the DrmInfoRequest class used for managing DRM information requests, including constants, nested iterator classes, and methods for handling key-value pairs related to DRM communication.

classes.name: DrmInfoRequest
classes.description: A utility class for passing parameters to communicate with online DRM servers, supporting key-value pairs and iteration over keys and values.

classes.name: DrmInfoRequest::KeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing keys in a DrmInfoRequest instance.

classes.name: DrmInfoRequest::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing values in a DrmInfoRequest instance.

methods.name: DrmInfoRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM info request with a specific type and MIME type.

methods.name: getInfoType
methods.description: Returns the type of DRM information requested.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type associated with the request.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value entries.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.

methods.name: keyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the keys.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the values.
